# Parley v0.1.46

One change, to the checks: the auxiliary window lifetime check no longer
fails on a busy runner, and its minimise assertions run for the first time.
The application is the v0.1.45 build with the same source.

## The auxiliary window check waits for the window server

The check that drives a real window through show, minimise, hide, orderOut,
reopen and close failed on the GitLab runner four times between 8 and
13 September, three times because content had not mounted 0.3 s after the
window was shown and once because ordering the window out did not release
it. The checks binary is an unbundled executable, so AppKit gives it a
prohibited activation policy: none of its windows can become key, and the
window root mounts or releases content only through the window server's
occlusion notification. That notification arrives tens to hundreds of
milliseconds after the ordering call, later on a loaded runner, and the
server coalesces it, so a window ordered out before the server ever reported
it on screen changes nothing and posts nothing. Fixed delays were the flake.

Every step of the scenario now reports done, pending or failed. A pending
step runs again on each driver tick until its fact holds, bounded at six
seconds, and a timeout or failure prints the window and application facts so
the next failure can be read from the CI trace. A step that acts on a shown
window first waits for the server to report it on screen, which is what makes
a later orderOut a real change.

## Minimise was never unavailable

The old check read `isMiniaturized` right after calling `miniaturize`, saw
false, printed "minimise is not available in this environment" on every run
and skipped those assertions. Minimise works in that process; the flag turns
true about half a second later, when the window reaches the Dock. The check
now waits up to two seconds for it, so the minimise, suspend and resume
assertions execute. Breaking the presence table so an ordered-out window
keeps its content, or so a minimised window keeps ticking, fails the check
with the facts.

`AGENTS.md` records these environment facts under Verification.

## Compatibility

Nothing in the application changed. Agent protocol unchanged at 32. No pane
needs a restart.

Validated: 346 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build; the lifetime check passed 6 sequential and 10 concurrent runs.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
